lines: World Bank Robert S. McNamara Fellowships Program 2022

World Bank Robert S. McNamara Fellowships Program 2022 is an initiative for graduates of master’s level studies. The World Bank

matches aspiring development economics researchers from developing countries with World Bank research economists, creating unique opportunities for the fellows to participate in rigorous policy-relevant research in the World Bank’s Development Economics Vice Presidency (DEC). The candidate will receive a fellowship of $42,750.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
No more than 35 years of age (by June 30 2022)
, with preference to nationals of developing countries
Have graduates of master’s level studies or currently pursuing a PhD in Economics or a related field

The RSMFP offers competitive compensation, totalling $42,750 net of income taxes per fellow for an 8-month fellowship (paid in monthly instalments). Since the fellows will be hosted at the World Bank in Washington D.C., the World Bank’s HR Operations unit will assist the selected candidates with their ap­plication for a G4 visa.
A statement of purpose describing their research interests, professional objectives, and discussing their qualifications as development researchers
Contact details for a reference who can provide a letter of recommendation (letters will only be requested for shortlisted candidates)

Fellowships will be awarded based on application materials, knowledge of relevant economic methods, and demonstrated skills in required statistical software. Cohort formation will seek to achieve geographical and gender representation.
The fellowship does not cover travel expenses.
